outcome.headline: Kimi cleared the final Mission Control CI gate without weakening the standard.
outcome.summary: A bounded correction reduced the unpiped lint count from 202 to 199 through three real code fixes. Kimi kept the baseline unchanged, added no suppressions, ran TypeScript and touched suites, committed 59044733, and received independent manager and CI confirmation before the mission merged.

changes.title: Replace undersized mission-control row identifiers
changes.why: The repository's id-length rule counted two newly introduced row identifiers and pushed CI above its accepted baseline.
changes.before: Two components used the generic identifier row, and the agent-row call site depended on the same ambiguous prop name.
changes.after: The identifiers now say laneRow and personRow, with the call site updated consistently.

changes.title: Split the oversized team-join test
changes.why: One 22-line test exceeded the repository's 20-line gate and mixed membership and presence behavior.
changes.before: testTeamJoin verified two concerns in one oversized test function.
changes.after: Membership and presence are verified in separate focused tests under the line limit.

decisions.title: Fix code instead of moving the lint baseline
decisions.rationale: The correction kept the measured baseline and suppression rules untouched. Three small naming and test-structure fixes were enough to move the count from 202 to 199.

decisions.title: Leave the optional max-lines cleanup alone
decisions.rationale: The requested gate was already green after the three bounded fixes. Extracting another presentational block would have expanded scope without improving the acceptance result.

problems.problem: The first prop rename briefly left both the old and new prop at one call site.
problems.resolution: Kimi noticed the duplicate during the same edit, removed the old row prop, and ran the gates on the corrected tree.

problems.problem: A previously delivered mission returned to red because its eslint count was 202 against a maximum of 200.
problems.resolution: The bounded correction reduced the unpiped count to 199, after which the manager independently reran the gate and CI passed.

artifacts.title: Bounded CI correction commit
artifacts.whatYouHaveNow: Commit 59044733 contains exactly four touched files, 19 insertions, and 9 deletions for the lint correction.

artifacts.title: Manager and CI verification
artifacts.whatYouHaveNow: The manager independently measured lint at 199, confirmed TypeScript clean, recorded CI run 29988240171 as green, and reported the mission merged.
